title.zh: 将东萨马省Guiuan市镇南萨马总医院床位由25张增至50张并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Southern Samar General Hospital in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Eastern Samar, From Twenty-Five to Fifty Beds, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Southern Samar General Hospital in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Eastern Samar, From Twenty-Five to Fifty Beds, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Đa khoa Southern Samar tại Đô thị Guiuan, Tỉnh Eastern Samar từ 25 lên 50 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลทั่วไป Southern Samar ในเทศบาล Guiuan จังหวัด Eastern Samar จาก 25 เป็น 50 เตียง และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Umum Southern Samar di Kotamadya Guiuan, Provinsi Eastern Samar dari 25 menjadi 50 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Besar Southern Samar di Perbandaran Guiuan, Wilayah Eastern Samar daripada 25 kepada 50 katil, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6575_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of Southern Samar General Hospital in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Eastern Samar, is increased from twenty-five to fifty beds.

In addition to its existing appropriation, there is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation and maintenance of the aforesaid hospital for the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy-one including the cost of the construction of additional building therefor. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without executive approval, September 30, 1972.
